title: 06/09/2023 - Software Updates | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
content: 06/09/2023 - Software Updates Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000094359 We made updates to several Default Widgets this week. If you have customized any of these widgets and would like to update your customized widget, you can find the latest code in the corresponding Default Widget. Please remember that if you have a custom version of any of these widgets, our latest updates have not been pushed to your website. We fixed an issue which was preventing the Date Picker field from correctly displaying on mobile devices in some cases. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - HEAD The "Enter Video URL" placeholder when uploading photos to a Multi-Image Post Type is now a Text Label. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Account - Edit Uploaded Photos Text Label Involved: enter_video_url We fixed an issue which was preventing the Sort Comments dropdown on Post Details pages from working properly in some cases. We fixed an issue which was causing Color Picker fields to remain open when navigating between tabs on the Design Settings page in the Admin. We fixed an issue which was causing Sub-Sub Categories with long names to be misaligned on member profile pages in some cases. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - HEAD We added the ability to use the Ctrl+S hotkey to save the General Settings page in the Admin. We added a Keyword Search in order to filter the results of the Digital Products and Pay Per Post options when creating Coupon Codes in the Admin. We added the Membership Plan name as part of the webhook data sent when signup forms are submitted. We fixed an issue with the Member Import Tool where member email addresses were not being autogenerated when the member import file did not contain email address information. We fixed an issue with the Affiliate Program Integration which was preventing the affiliate information from being sent properly when the Membership Plan's name contained an apostrophe. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Conversion Tracking Codes The action of a member purchasing or accepting a lead will now be recorded in the Activity Tracker. We fixed an issue with the Reviews homepage widget which was preventing the system from returning results when using the random display order and limiting one review per member in some cases. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Display - Recent Reviews We updated the logic of the Event Datepicker search field in order to allow the selection of past dates when the "Display Expired Post in Search Results" Post Type setting is active. Widgets Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Homepage Search - Events Search Bootstrap Theme - Module - Event Search We updated the logic of how the system displays the distance to each member when performing location searches that include members with Service Areas. Widget Involved: Search - Member - Search Query We fixed an issue which was preventing the Lead Submission form from being submitted when using a custom dropdown label that contained the $ symbol in some cases. We created a new Advanced Setting called "Froala Remove Attributes When Pasting Text". When HTML attributes are added to this setting, those attributes will be removed automatically from content pasted into Froala WYSIWYGs. We fixed an issue which was preventing the system from removing member sub-category selections from the database when deleting members in bulk from the Admin in some cases. For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard . Was this article helpful and accurate?
